detailed_descriptions.en: Co-working just got cuter! On-Together: Virtual Co-Working is a digital third space designed to help you focus and stay connected. Work or study with your friends and strangers from all over the world! Features: Co-work with friends or strangers in a cozy virtual workspace. Play in fullscreen, on the side of your screen or in transparent sticker mode. Use productivity tools including a customisable Pomodoro timer and to-do list to stay on track. Your avatars all sit together in the corner of your screen while you work. Meet up in a variety of locations including a library, treehouse and floating lily pads! Find the focus animation for your character that matches your real life task, like reading, doing chores or painting. Make your avatar your own, choosing from a huge variety of human and animal customisation options. Earn tickets as you focus that you can trade for new clothing, power ups, pet companions AND MORE! Take regular breaks and play minigames like basketball, fishing or music jams! Hang out! Lock in! Repeat!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Co-working just got cuter!

On-Together: Virtual Co-Working is a digital third space designed to help you focus and stay connected. Work or study with your friends and strangers from all over the world!

Features:

  • Co-work with friends or strangers in a cozy virtual workspace.

  • Play in fullscreen, on the side of your screen or in transparent sticker mode.

  • Use productivity tools including a customisable Pomodoro timer and to-do list to stay on track.

  • Your avatars all sit together in the corner of your screen while you work.

  • Meet up in a variety of locations including a library, treehouse and floating lily pads! 

  • Find the focus animation for your character that matches your real life task, like reading, doing chores or painting.

  • Make your avatar your own, choosing from a huge variety of human and animal customisation options.

  • Earn tickets as you focus that you can trade for new clothing, power ups, pet companions AND MORE!

  • Take regular breaks and play minigames like basketball, fishing or music jams!

Hang out! Lock in! Repeat!
